name: @epoch/observability
description: Epoch Observability kernel (W030) — the security-domain observation model: typed, versioned, sealed SECURITY OBSERVATIONS (content-addressed, W006 exact-revision provenance) over the execution surfaces; SECURITY POLICY as data (tenant-scoped isolation profiles + audit thresholds; swapping a policy revision changes enforcement with zero code change); the W008-mirrored SANDBOX ISOLATION CHECK (trust-class ceilings, legal grant tables, flavor/data-handling admission, listing requirements — parity-pinned, never a runtime edge); the QUARANTINE fact model (append-only impose/release records, deny-by-default); the deterministic metrics fold + security-health projection; the AUDIT FAMILIES (tenant-boundary breach detection + W041 access-projection invariant verification); and the security:* event vocabulary over the W010 event shapes. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary; zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied.
